svg.title: The Vanilla Shop: Natural Vanilla Tea, 12 bags

g.text: One tea bag in hot water
Or cool it, pour over ice
The delicate sweetness of natural vanilla
Made with vanilla grown on our own farms.
Ceylon black tea with natural vanilla,
in 12 tagged unbleached sachet tea bags.

text.textPath: SAVOR THE CALM · AUTHENTIC CEYLON VANILLA TEA ·
